text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more... Just a bit 
further... But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Still... out of reach. Hehe... You really 
are amazing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...They're here. The pests.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I can't see it with my own eyes. I don't 
even know if it really exists. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe... can see it. She's dead serious 
about chasing after 'that thing'..."

After the race, Jungle Pocket stared 
blankly at Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal, Cafe? With that... 
"friend" of yours?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What does it mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Cafe... is that you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Past and future. Where it all leads..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
oWaiChaWnnhU saolRiroaoe a aotoFsdi 
rsnMllistgnnHeei lm Hnu tnwl egd...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with you all of a sudden?! 
Gross...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: To me, my "friend" is—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She looks... very similar to me. Yet, 
perhaps she isn't me.

And after wrapping up all the post-race 
matters—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It might be something like... an ideal.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's the thing Cafe's chasing 
after. She called it 'the me that isn't 
me' or something."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We aren't her rivals. But, when she 
catches up to her own ideal—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's possible she's become the strongest 
of them all. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just chase your ideals, and everything 
will come true. Maybe that's Cafe's way of 
aiming for the top.

Narita Top Road is "climbing a mountain." 
Manhattan Cafe is "her ideal self."

Though their visions may differ, each 
strives to be the strongest at their own 
pace and in their own way.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it intensely all over again. 
Every single one of 'em is different, and 
every single one of 'em is strong.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't see it when Opera O was around, 
but everyone really has such strong 
backbones, don't they.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Will the serious one win, will the eerie 
one win, or is there someone else 
entirely...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We won't know everything— until autumn or 
later, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there seem to be others too. For 
instance, there might still be someone 
hiding their true colors even in the 
Classic class.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"They will all be gathered by the end of 
this year. In other words—the battle for 
the absolute strongest begins after that."

It's true that there might still be unseen 
rising contenders. The two who ran today 
have stood out since last year, but—

There will likely be new contenders 
emerging as well. All the actors will be 
assembled this autumn...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, let's aim for that race one 
more time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A place where the best of not just this 
country, but the entire world gather. And—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That race from last year, where I went 
toe-to-toe with T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. At Tokyo Racecourse, the home-field 
advantage is mine. That's where—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Back-to-back championship! Let's nail it 
down. First, a preemptive strike on the 
road to becoming the strongest.

Back-to-back Japan Cup victories. If she 
truly achieves that, Jungle Pocket will 
surely be recognized as the Umamusume 
closest to the title of the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Then we start getting ready first 
thing tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, let's scope out what kind of crazy 
monsters show up before the Japan Cup. 
Keep your eyes peeled, partner!
